column1: # gold_paradigm_headwords.tsv — reviewed headword assignments for Alypy paradigm tables whose
# printed exemplar does not resolve to a registered lemma: tables with no exemplar (§81 бы́ти,
# §97 нестѝ, §103 archaic verbs, §47 себѐ, §48 что̀/толи́къ), tables headed by an inflected form
# (мꙋ́др-а, є҆ди́н-а, творѧ́й, та́ѧ), and multi-word or titlo-printed exemplars (бж҃ї-й кра́-й).
# The table's own printed forms identify the lexeme; the assignment is review data whose
# provenance is the section. Read by the gold gate (crates/xtask/src/synodal_gold.rs) only
# after the printed headword itself fails to resolve; it never changes the comparison contract.
# column_label empty = every column of the table; surface_prefix (accentless, dehyphenated)
# separates the lexemes of a table that interleaves several paradigms (§103).
